definitions.active_visible_time: Use valid linked cumulative opening checkpoints to assess engagement qualification, including nonfinal checkpoints. Do not add cumulative checkpoint values together. Calculate completed-opening timing averages separately using final valid checkpoints only.
definitions.checkpoint_semantics: Cumulative checkpoints describe progress within the same opening and must not be summed. A valid linked nonfinal checkpoint with cumulative_active_ms >= 10000 can establish provisional engagement without a final checkpoint. Completed-opening timing averages use only final valid checkpoints.
definitions.comparison_picker: Opening a comparison picker does not count as a displayed comparison.
definitions.qualifying_comparison: A comparison qualifies only when it is displayed and linked to a valid dish opening.
definitions.considered_dish: A dish qualifies when a valid linked opening checkpoint reaches at least 10000 milliseconds of cumulative active-visible time, even if the checkpoint is nonfinal, OR when there is a qualifying displayed comparison. A final checkpoint is not required for provisional engagement qualification.
definitions.short_opening: Opening a dish for fewer than 10 seconds does not automatically establish meaningful engagement.
definitions.deduplication: Count each qualifying dish once per visit.

comparison_attribution.current_test_assumption: Only the dish linked to the opening qualifies.
comparison_attribution.unresolved_question: Should a displayed comparison qualify both displayed dishes?
